claims.text: Your unpublished results show the sulfonated CNF membrane completing 500 hours of cycling at 20 mA cm-2 with coulombic efficiency above 98 %.
Iodide crossover stayed below the UV-vis detection limit after 300 hours of cycling.
You have already published a sulfonated cellulose nanofibre ion-selective membrane for zinc-iodine redox flow batteries.
Cellulose nanofibres already reinforce cellulose acetate membranes, so membrane-grade CNF processing is established.
Publications and patents on nanocelluloses have been increasing every year.
Only 427 works since 2021 match 'cellulose separator zinc iodine battery', a thin literature for cellulose separators in zinc-iodine cells.
Stability beyond 1,000 hours is still an open question in your own data.
